origin.quote: You can bring only one carry-on item along with your personal item. Your carry-on must fit in in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of you. If it doesn't fit, it will need to be checked.

source_obligations.statement: In manifest order, exclude no more than one bag that satisfies every carry-on dimension cap before assigning checked-bag positions.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Calculate checked-bag size by adding its three outside dimensions.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For a bag that is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher of those two excess fees to the checked-position fee.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Return the ticket price plus the base and applicable excess fee for every checked bag.
